title: Algebraization over a fixed Chow modification
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian I-adically complete ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], Z Noetherian, and f : Z → Spec A separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let Q = I O_Z and G be a coherent formal Q-module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] whose degree-zero support is proper over A [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Given a proper q : Y → Z, a natural number n, an immersion e : Y → ProjectiveSpace (ULift (Fin (n+1))) (Spec A), an equation identifying its projection with q followed by f, and an ideal sheaf L on Z with nonempty support complement over which q is an isomorphism, there exists a coherent module F on Y [pqf-def-coherent], an isomorphism from the tensor pullback of G to the Q.comap q completion of F, and proper support over A of q_*F.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: Apply exists_chow_algebraization_core with hR to obtain F, its completion comparison, and proper support over A on Y. Apply chow_algebraization_pushforward_support to that proper-support hypothesis; combine the two conclusions with the same F.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 088E, compactification/algebraization followed by proper pushforward support; corrected in the second reading by V1

theorem exists_chow_algebraization_data
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (n : ℕ)
    (e : Y ⟶ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)))
    [IsImmersion e]
    (he : e ≫ (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) =
      q ≫ f)
    (L : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hL : (L.support.compl : Set Z).Nonempty)
    (hIso : IsIso (pullback.snd q (Scheme.Opens.ι L.support.compl))) :
    ∃ F : CoherentModules Y,
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj)
